name: Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound
summary: In northern Stranglethorn Vale, Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound lies south of Zul'Gurub's ruins. The Mosh'Ogg tribe holds its fortified caverns under Mai'Zoth, their ruthless ogre mage chieftain.

sections.title: A Den of Ogres
sections.body: Mosh'Ogg ogres fill the jungle caverns south of Zul'Gurub. Maulers, shamans, and warmongers guard the twisting passages. The tribe seized the ridges as a refuge from hostile jungle trolls and prowling beasts.

sections.title: Mai'Zoth and the Mind's Eye
sections.body: Mai'Zoth commands the Mosh'Ogg clan from deep within the mound. The formidable chieftain has two heads and practices ogre magic. He holds the Mind's Eye, a potent and dangerous arcane relic. Its power strengthens his hold over his followers through mind and sorcery. His magic and brute force make the mound's deepest reaches perilous for travelers in northern Stranglethorn.

faq.q: Who lives in the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound?
faq.answer: The Mosh'Ogg ogre tribe lives in the mound, including warriors, maulers, shamans, and warmongers. Their two-headed ogre mage chieftain, Mai'Zoth, rules from deep within the cavern.
The Mind's Eye is a potent magical artifact held by Mai'Zoth inside the mound. Its arcane power fuels his sorcery and his command over the local ogres.
The mound lies in northern Stranglethorn Vale, in the hills just south of Zul'Gurub's entrance.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see Mai'Zoth wielding the Mind's Eye deep within the mound. Its raw arcane energy is unusual for brute ogres.
